subject.title: fix(clickclack): deliver media and configurable model replies [AI-assisted]

question: What should an unset ClickClack model-mode account use for its completion budget, given that 96 preserves compatibility but the submitted live evidence shows it can suppress replies?
rationale: Source and live evidence establish the reliability problem, but choosing between provider cost/latency and a higher or runtime-owned default is a product policy decision rather than a mechanical correctness fix.

options.title: Use the runtime or model default
options.body: Omit the explicit cap when unset, if the LLM contract supports that, so provider/model policy owns the budget without adding a known-failing ClickClack default.

options.title: Select a safer ClickClack default
options.body: Retain the config field but replace 96 with a maintainer-approved budget and document the resulting latency and provider-usage tradeoff.

options.title: Split the token change
options.body: Land the media fix separately and defer configurable model budgets until the default and cost policy are explicitly sponsored.

recommendation.title: Use the runtime or model default
recommendation.body: Omit the explicit cap when unset, if the LLM contract supports that, so provider/model policy owns the budget without adding a known-failing ClickClack default.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice affects first-party ClickClack behavior, provider usage, configuration surface, and compatibility policy rather than only implementation mechanics.
